issues.description: The UML and problem description define numberOfTutors as an int, but the solution implementation declares the field as a short and defines the constructor and setter to use short. This deviates from the specified attribute type and can cause mismatch with expected getter/setter signatures in tests or student implementations (e.g., tests or student code passing int literals to the setter will not match a short parameter without a cast).
issues.suggestedFix: Use int consistently for numberOfTutors across the solution (declare the field as int, update the constructor parameter and setter to accept int). Ensure getter and setter signatures match the UML/problem specification so students and tests can use int values without casting.
